files.name: WaterStairOut.java

help: Stuck in cave water and goto surface found no way up: rise to the waterline and dig steps up into the dry wall
lesson: goto surface's staircase judges the cells at the feet, which are all water when the bot is swimming underground; starting the staircase one block up, from the waterline into the dry wall, avoids the water entirely.
summary: water_stair_out: after goto surface fails UNREACHABLE because stairs see water on every side, swim to the waterline and dig a staircase starting above the water
